name: System architect
summary: Designs and reviews software and cloud systems for small teams, turning goals into clear designs, decision records, diagrams and trade-offs before costly choices are made.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources, four skills (architecture review, architecture decision record, system design doc with C4 diagrams in Mermaid, threat model), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
